how: Members propose making a mark, announce joining, and recruit helpers to construct the attacked logo.
The proposer asks whether the mark can happen and later supplies its anchor coordinates, without establishing who first placed a pixel.
The first assent asks for nothing back, unlike the later acceptance that also asks for Discord.
The opening proposal receives a bare yes, establishing one acceptance pair without establishing a norm for all readers or refusals.
A proposal gives respondents something to join and later invitations gather around a mark, although the opening start and call share one utterance.
Help is requested under attack, but neither numerical shortage nor inadequate space is expressly diagnosed.
The joiner asks for Discord rather than canvas rules, and the supplied coordinates do not explain controls or the timer.
Dismissal and collective self-mockery do not show a member quitting under strain or a quarrel being repaired.
The opening proposes a mark and later recruitment identifies the IBO logo, while the unavailable image prevents reconstructing its proposed design.
Recruitment reports that the logo is being constructed and finally getting somewhere, establishing reported progress rather than independently verified placing.
The proposer supplies one anchor coordinate with an instruction to eyeball the mark rather than a pixel template.
Members route live organisation to Discord, locate its off-topic channel, and answer a later Discord question with the sidebar location.
Joining is joked about as time that should go to revision and recruitment explicitly offers procrastination, without measuring actual study time lost.
Construction and defensive recruitment are reported without evidence about scripts, bots or spare accounts.
Coordinate and sidebar directions concern finding the effort, not reported client faults or technical fixes.
Private messages are offered for supervisor contact information, not for hiding strategy from rivals or infiltrating their venues.
Visible venue directions establish coordination but cannot establish whether unseen chat participants decided leadership, voting or divisions of work.
Calls precede reported construction, but no reply or participant explanation establishes that these calls brought the hands that built.
An anchor coordinate follows assent, without visible design argument settled by an agreed pixel template.
Warnings and recruitment rally defence of a work in progress, without documenting individual repairs or restoration of planned changes.
The work is described as under attack while still being constructed, fitting defence of placed parts without requiring completion of the whole mark.
Attack warnings name no changer, motive, friendly fire or officer responsible for damage.
Defensive strain is reported without a subsequent report of scripts or spare accounts.
Warnings do not identify an appeal to an attacker, restraint of the room's attackers or neighbour repair.
Recruitment under attack supplies no border proposal, negotiated truce or agreement with another room.
Failure talk and a next-time wish do not report losing a particular spot and relocating.
The help appeal addresses willing participants without identifying another room supplying or trading help.
An organising Discord is named without evidence of a coalition or joint work by multiple rooms.
No named canvas host, permission request or hosting rule is evidenced by the logo recruitment.
No member is shown carrying terms on behalf of the room to another community.
Neither authority to commit the room nor limits on binding placers are discussed in the visible organising directions.
The anchor locates the effort but does not document choosing among sites, moving, shrinking or refusing relocation.
Attack warnings do not become an argument over whether covering another work is fair.
No participant reports belonging to both sides of a contest or receiving reassurance about divided allegiance.
Warnings establish defensive pressure but no subsequent neighbour negotiation through which to test the proposed mechanism.
No negotiated border and subsequent restraint pair is available to test compliance with an agreement.
Internal recruitment under attack does not establish a turn to another room or incoming help.
No border agreement and ensuing exchange of help are available to test the proposed channel.
The record supplies attacks and chat recruitment but no multi-room defensive coalition.
The bounded arrow cannot be tested without a visible agreement, terms-making disclaimer or appeal about representative authority.
A next-time wish does not supply a shortage diagnosis followed by relocation.
Participants translate the effort and its final result into familiar revision, CAS, IA and art-rationale language.
An off-colour globe receives a mock art rationale that replies elaborate through tears, sweat and an IB student's futile endeavours.
IB programme language supplies shared identity without naming an inherited rivalry or pre-canvas quarrel.
Helpers are directed to an existing channel without evidence that a new canvas-born room or faction formed around the mark.
A dismissive insult about a warning does not establish objections to offensive jokes, slurs or hate symbols.
One participant dismisses the warning as cancer and redirects it to another subreddit, establishing a member's boundary claim rather than moderator policy.
Schoolwork parody is visible, but no coded fake, takeover or April Fools licence establishes host-wide keying as play.
The objector redirects the warning without reporting sabotage or asking trolls to destroy the room's own mark.
A warning receives a dismissive redirect after the close, but neither a flood nor a causal response to excessive calls is evidenced.
A final-mark announcement receives pride alongside sadness, failure talk and self-mockery rather than unanimous celebration.
The final-mark post records the end and its replies mourn and assess the result, without independently verifying the linked image.
The failed-mission reply wishes to get them next time, fitting the element's minimal range without demonstrating any organised continuation.
The joking denial of failure supplies an alternative appraisal but does not establish correction of a historical account or contest over a preserved version.
Anticipated worldwide recognition does not document a visitor, returning member, subscriber gain or reception of newcomers.
The boast names no creator, team, company or press addressee and reports no external acknowledgement.
The final post points to a mark without an earlier done report establishing completion as the cause of shared celebration.
Announcement and recording coincide in the final post, so celebration producing a later decision to preserve is not demonstrated.
A reply to the final record promises next time, providing a minimal textual passage from remembrance to a future wish.
Being under attack does not establish that these participants attacked another work.
Failure and next-time talk do not identify a rival or carry on an inter-room contest in talk.
Shared IB language and anonymous attack warnings provide no named rival or attack turn linking prior identity to a target.
Calls recruit logo helpers without evidencing a subsequent turn by those helpers against a rival.
No outgoing attack call and reasoned refusal pair is available to test the proposed response.
No outgoing attack call and invocation of a truce are available to test the proposed response.
Anonymous defensive warnings provide no outgoing attack and ensuing named-rival taunts.
Members make the effort count as needed programme work and seek a supervisor, a practical use of participation beyond shared jokes or competition for study time.
A request for CAS supervision receives agreement and an offer of private contact, connecting programme recognition to a practical organising route.
Acceptance coupled with a Discord question receives a sidebar direction, making venue-finding part of joining rather than a uniformly bare commitment.
A warning's only visible reply rejects its practical framing by redirecting it elsewhere rather than joining defence.
The final record invites mixed evaluations, including pride, rather than documenting celebration that first caused preservation.
Replies turn the recorded mark into a shared mock art rationale through successive interpretations of its colours and student effort.
